template: trade_when(or(greater(ts_rank(vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets}, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 21), std=4)), 126), 0.8), less(ts_rank(vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets}, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 21), std=4)), 126), 0.2)), vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets}, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 21), std=4)), 0)
idea: 关注权益配置残差在其自身历史时序中的相对位置而非绝对水平，构建126日（6个月）滚动窗口的时序分位数指标；仅当当前配置强度处于历史最高20%（极度自信）或最低20%（极度防御）时才保留信号，中间分位区间视为噪音并强制置零；该模板利用trade_when实现区间择时，适用于捕捉基金经理配置行为的极端偏离与情绪拐点。
expression_list: trade_when(or(greater(ts_rank(vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill(inst16_ipreo_fundreportedequityassets, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill(fund_reported_asset_value, 21), std=4)), 126), 0.8), less(ts_rank(vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill(inst16_ipreo_fundreportedequityassets, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill(fund_reported_asset_value, 21), std=4)), 126), 0.2)), vector_neut(winsorize(ts_backfill(inst16_ipreo_fundreportedequityassets, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill(fund_reported_asset_value, 21), std=4)), 0)
